name: sprite-motion-kit
description: Custom game actions, 3D references, optional MXAPI image-to-Seedance video generation, transparent sprite export and visual review.

interface.shortDescription: Create character actions from poses or image-to-video.
interface.longDescription: Design custom character motions or use your MXAPI image and Seedance account for continuous action videos. Local tools render references, extract transparent frames and synchronize visual review. No account, model weights or credits bundled; generated motion still needs review.
defaultPrompt: Use my existing image and Seedance account to make a side-view character-action video, then export transparent frames and show the original/video-frame comparison. Keep the repository private and test one sample first.
Create a body-appropriate monster collapse with its own rig and key poses.
Author a custom motion plan for this character and show the 3D reference before generating its animation.
